description: This file implements the initialization, creation, and removal functions for a COSA backend manager object, including setting up external dependencies and internal state management.

methods.name: CosaBackEndManagerCreate
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new COSA backend manager object, returning its handle.

methods.name: CosaBackEndManagerInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the backend manager object, creating internal components like MTA.

methods.name: CosaBackEndManagerRemove
methods.description: Removes and frees the backend manager object, including its internal components.
